title: dev.qory.runtime.message
description: A message of a subagent between its start and its end, as the runtime printed it on its standard output.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

agent_id.description: The subagent the message belongs to.

role.description: Who wrote the message, in the runtime's words: assistant, user.

kind.description: text for a reply, thinking for the model's reasoning, in the runtime's words.
